versions.changelog: Token验证全面修复：URL改为geo-api.yk-global.com/validate；新增本地缓存5分钟

Initial release: multi-platform order profit calculator with auto field mapping.

- Upload order exports from any e-commerce platform or ERP to get instant profit breakdowns by order, store, SKU, and platform.
- Agent-powered field mapping automatically recognizes and standardizes 38+ common field names across platforms.
- Provides overall, per-platform, per-store summaries, as well as highlighting top and bottom orders by profit.
- Validates per-order profit calculations and cross-checks with platform-declared profits.
- Supports all major platforms (e.g., Temu, TikTok Shop, Shein, Allegro, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, etc.); works with any export containing standard fields.
- CLI scripts included for file parsing and field mapping review.
